conversion.oklch: L = percent/100; a = C*cos(h*pi/180); b = C*sin(h*pi/180); powerless hue none = 0
conversion.gamut: Clip each encoded sRGB channel to [0,1], multiply by 255, round to nearest integer. gamut=true means an unclipped linear channel lies outside [0,1] by more than 1e-7. Distances use original OKLab, not clipped hex.
